description: This file defines the SugarFieldFloat class, which extends SugarFieldInt, providing functionality for formatting, unformatting, and sanitizing float fields within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for formatting numbers according to precision, converting formatted strings back to float values, and sanitizing input values for import.

classes.name: SugarFieldFloat
classes.description: A class that handles float field operations, extending SugarFieldInt, including formatting and sanitization.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats a raw float value according to specified precision, returning an empty string if input is null or empty.

methods.name: unformatField
methods.description: Converts a formatted string back to a float, returning an empty string if input is null or empty.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes a value for import by removing group separators, replacing decimal separators, and validating that the result is numeric.
